statement: Watch the previous star sign video first; this video covers constellation locations and how to get them for worlds 1 to 4.
Some constellations are a huge pain and should probably be skipped.
Blunder Hills top right corner constellation: reach level 30 on four players; easy.
Branches End constellation: AFK one plus hours; could use a Time Candy or just wait.
Valley of the Beans constellation beside the logs: reach the star on four players.
Tucked Away at the end of the map (gigafrog): reach the star on three players.
Office constellation: kill Dr Ficus on three players.
Freefall Caverns under the portal: reach the star with any Archer; do mining quest prologue then mine copper about an hour.
Winding Willows bottom platform: AFK 24 hours on two players.
After AFKing 24 plus hours click the constellation on that character to make sure it counts.
Froggy Fields world coliseum constellation at bottom right: clear the coliseum on three players and click it before leaving.
Amarok boss map right side: kill Amarok in under 20 seconds on three players.
Amarok kill is easy once in World 2 or 3 and a little difficult in World 1 but no issues.
Echoing Egress: reach the star as any Mage class.
Skip Echoing Egress: needs about mining level 45 on a mage which is time consuming and monotonous.
Mimic spawn point at bottom left of platform: reach the star on three players.
Far Away Piers: reach the star as any Mage class; need fishing up.
Takes some time but AFK gains and XP percent make it no problem.
Grandioso Canyon left of portal entrance: AFK 36 hours on three players and click it.
Complete the Coliseum at the mimic hole on four players.
Efaunt's Tomb bottom left platform: defeat Efaunt as a beginner class; journeyman or maestro also work.
Cactus near moon men: AFK 48 hours on three players.
Yum Yum Grotto: reach level 65 on four players.
After the chat bubble update the constellation is more hidden than usual.
Frostbite Tundra left of world 4 portal: reach level 90 on six players.
Steep Sheep Ledge far bottom right: defeat a sheepie bare-handed on four players; unequip weapon then click.
Trapper's Folly left portal of town: reach trapping level 15 on five players.
Refrigeration Station bottom left of bloke zone: AFK 60 plus hours on three players.
Rolling Tundra bottom right: reach wave 11 on four players; probably need about level 20 Boulder Rollers.
Boulder Roller level needed requires some construction work over time.
Thermonuclear Climb bottom right of third Meister map: AFK 11 plus hours on nine players.
He hasn't done this one yet; requires unlocking all nine characters; not suggested to skip.
Crystal Base Camp top right: reach the star on six players; push every character to that point.
Hell Hath Frozen Over after Rams map: kill a Blood Bone on four players; takes many kills to get there.
World 4 town stalagmite top of kitchen far left: reach level 120 on eight players.
Many World 4 constellations are very time consuming so don't expect them right away.
Spaceway Raceway bottom left under portal: defeat all mushrooms before any respawn on three players.
Strongly suggests taking all mob respawn off your character before attempting this constellation.
Donut Drive-in under Oinken: reach level 15 on four players; incredibly time consuming.
Worm Highway left side out of portal: reach the star on three players; easy.
Cocoa Tunnel top platform: defeat all mobs before respawn on four players (feed old jockeys?).
Take away all mob respawn for Cocoa Tunnel.
Do Cocoa Tunnel on a shaman or barbarian or anything with AOE and great clearing speed.
Stand Still Plains below the portal: reach the star on four players; easy.
Shelled Shores after portal: hit a mega crit on a clammie on four players.
Mega crit is the last talent book in the Flurbo shop; gives extra damage after exceeding 100 percent crit chance.
Once you get a constellation you never have to get it again.
